subject.title: fix(gateway): recover when suppressed channel secrets are unavailable

question: Should `secrets.reload` remain lifecycle-neutral while crash-loop safe mode is active, or may it automatically restart channel accounts that an operator previously started?
rationale: Current documentation defines explicit `channels.start` as the safe-mode override, while this PR intentionally introduces automatic account restarts and the competing PR avoids that policy change.

options.title: Preserve the current contract
options.body: Keep `secrets.reload` lifecycle-neutral in safe mode and select or narrow a candidate to the startup source/assignment projection fix only.

options.title: Approve account-aware restarts
options.body: Accept this new safe-mode contract only with explicit owner approval, updated operational documentation, and exact-head proof for stop, timeout, rollback, retry, and restart behavior.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Hold both PRs until the Gateway owner defines one canonical recovery transaction and closes the competing implementation path.

recommendation.title: Preserve the current contract
recommendation.body: Keep `secrets.reload` lifecycle-neutral in safe mode and select or narrow a candidate to the startup source/assignment projection fix only.

likelyOwner.reason: Their earlier crash-loop breaker work is the clearest available provenance for the safe-mode lifecycle contract being changed.
